Nora Kim: Quick plan: add new indexed column session_last_seen to sessions table during 02:00 UTC change window. Small backfill ~6m. Need pin and a short canary.

Ravi Patel: Can we pin auth-service to v3.2.1? v3.3 caused lock spikes last week.

Nora Kim: Yes pin to v3.2.1. Proposed rollback triggers: P95 latency up >120ms for 5m OR error rate >1% for 2m OR lock events >8 (duration>30s) in 10m.

Ravi Patel: Add replica lag guard: pause if lag>40s for 90s. Backfill throttle 150 r/s.

deploy-bot: Created job migrator/job/1912345670-sessions-lastseen. Canary=1 node (1% sample). CLI: `deploybot start migrator/job/1912345670-sessions-lastseen --canary --pin-version v3.2.1 --holdpoint canary:6m`

sre-bot: Alert rules applied: DB_LOCKS -> @eng-sre pager if lock_count>8 in 10m; REPLICA_LAG -> page if lag>40s for 2m.

Nora Kim: Internal runbook will be at docs/runbooks/migrations/sessions_lastseen_20260323.md. I'll post link when uploaded. Thanks everyone.
